fashionpedia_notes.txt:
Reusable notes from examples:
- 13 glasses: thin metal/clear frames; can be small/partly occluded.
- 14 hat: worn on head, including soft brimmed hats/caps; if the red box captures the hat rather than hair accessory, use hat.
- 27 hood: garment hood visible behind/around neck/head opening of a jacket/coat/hoodie. Example 61 shows just the hood portion of a jacket/outerwear.
- 30 epaulette: small shoulder decoration/strap on outerwear. Example 43 is a shoulder epaulette-like strap, not sleeve or zipper.
- Confusion tips: very small metallic/strap-like details on shoulders of jackets/coats may be epaulettes; headwear vs hair accessory depends on whether it sits as worn headgear (hat) versus hair band/clips (headband/hair accessory).
